description: This file defines the CalendarAccountValidationService class responsible for validating calendar account data in a SuiteCRM module, including checks for account limits, user permissions, and duplicate external calendar entries.

classes.name: CalendarAccountValidationService
classes.description: Service class for validating CalendarAccount entities, ensuring business rules are followed regarding account limits, permissions, and duplicates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a CalendarAccount and a User object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs all validation checks and returns true if all pass, false otherwise.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of validation error messages.

methods.name: getFirstError
methods.description: Returns the first validation error message, or null if none exist.

methods.name: validatePersonalAccountLimit
methods.description: Checks if a user is exceeding personal account limits.

methods.name: validateGroupAccountCreation
methods.description: Ensures only admins can create group calendar accounts.

methods.name: validateDuplicateExternalCalendar
methods.description: Detects whether an external calendar has already been linked to another account.
